prompt: Explain to me like I’m 5 the theory one can color in each map with 4 colors
response: Sure! Imagine you have a map with different countries, and you want to color them so no two countries that touch share the same color. The Four Color Theorem says you only need four colors to do this. It's like having a crayon box with just four colors, and you can color any map without worrying about running out or needing more colors.
